```{=html}
<section id="research" class="qs-home-section qs-philosophy" data-compatibility-route="research/index.html">
<p class="qs-section-kicker">RESEARCH</p>
<h2>From marine observations to reproducible evidence</h2>
<p class="qs-section-lead">Connecting ecology, data, and decisions in dynamic marine systems.</p>
<div class="qs-principles">
<article><span class="qs-principle-number">01</span><h3>Measure change.</h3><p>Marine populations are dynamic. Indicators and models should preserve their temporal and spatial structure.</p></article>
<article><span class="qs-principle-number">02</span><h3>Model uncertainty.</h3><p>Evidence is more useful when uncertainty, alternative mechanisms, and model limitations are explicit.</p></article>
<article><span class="qs-principle-number">03</span><h3>Inform decisions.</h3><p>Analytical complexity matters when it improves interpretation, reproducibility, and fisheries decisions.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="qs-theme-grid">
<div class="qs-theme-item"><strong>Population dynamics &amp; stock assessment</strong><span>Recruitment, growth, selectivity, demographic structure, uncertainty, and management-oriented assessment.</span></div>
<div class="qs-theme-item"><strong>Spatio-temporal marine ecology</strong><span>Habitat, distribution shifts, accessibility, hotspots, fleet behaviour, and spatial models.</span></div>
<div class="qs-theme-item"><strong>Environmental variability &amp; ecosystem responses</strong><span>Oceanographic and climatic drivers, ecosystem regimes, and pressure–state relationships.</span></div>
<div class="qs-theme-item"><strong>Statistical ecology &amp; scientific computing</strong><span>Hierarchical, additive, multivariate, machine-learning, and reproducible modelling workflows.</span></div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="qs-home-section">
<div class="qs-section-heading"><div><p class="qs-section-kicker">CURRENT RESEARCH</p><h2>Manuscripts and analyses in development</h2></div><a class="qs-text-link" href="projects/">View all projects →</a></div>
<div class="qs-feature-grid">
<article class="qs-feature-card"><p class="qs-card-meta">STOCK ASSESSMENT · MACHINE LEARNING</p><h3>Diagnosing stock-assessment misspecification with machine learning</h3><p>Testing whether multivariate assessment diagnostics can identify the structural process responsible for model misspecification.</p><a href="projects/stock-assessment-misspecification/">Explore project →</a></article>
<article class="qs-feature-card"><p class="qs-card-meta">ANCHOVETA · IN-SEASON BENCHMARKING</p><h3>Standardizing in-season benchmarking for a highly variable small-pelagic fishery</h3><p>Comparing active seasons through season day, effective fishing day, quota progress, historical envelopes, and environmental adjustment.</p><a href="projects/season-benchmarking/">Explore project →</a></article>
<article class="qs-feature-card"><p class="qs-card-meta">PELAGIC FISHERIES · LONG-TERM CHANGE</p><h3>Long-term reorganization of Peruvian pelagic fisheries</h3><p>Evaluating changes in composition, effort, efficiency, seasonality, spatial footprint, and their relationship with environmental variability.</p><a href="projects/pelagic-fishery-reorganization/">Explore project →</a></article>
</div>
```
